notes.title: The Courier Steam Next Fest Demo!
notes.content:
Hello Couriers in training!

For the Steam Next Fest, we've squashed some reported bugs, and made the demo overall a better experience! Check the fixes below.


Fixed the first npc that asks you to deliver his letter dialogue so now you won't be stuck on it
Fixed the lock kid part, it would be automatically completed so you didn't have to open the gate
Fixed a glitch where you could spam the ringbell in the office and get a ton of quests lol
Fixed a major bug that made you stuck in henry's cave
Added 960x540 resolution
Fixed a bug where you wouldn't see the speech bubble when trying to buy glasses without money
Added a button to set the game in windowed mode
Changed the behavior for the camera movement on dialogues, now it won't zoom out and in for each bubble.
Added support for arrow keys for movement and menu
Added support for enter for interaction keys

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933200/The_Courier_Demo/

Enjoy!
📨
